notes: CT only — reject MRI, X-ray, and ultrasound requests immediately.

Does NOT handle lesions, tumors, COVID-19 or free-text pathology.
Input must be 3D NIfTI (.nii or .nii.gz) — no DICOM, no 2D slices.
GPU strongly recommended — CPU takes 30-60 mins per scan.
Supports 9 modalities — use for anything non-CT or when lesion/tumor segmentation needed.
3D NIfTI supported — processed slice-by-slice with 3D context.
Has recognition mode — can auto-detect all objects without prompt.
Can detect if a structure is ABSENT from the image (negative detection).
Soft validation: warns if prompt not in recommended list but still runs.
GPU required — CPU is extremely slow.
Status: not yet integrated — placeholder for future use.
